stories.headline: Peter Thiel-backed fintech Majority merges with Swedish telco Rebtel
stories.quote: Exclusive: Peter Thiel-backed fintech Majority, founded in Sweden, has merged with Swedish telco Rebtel.

stories.headline: Starling Bank CEO Raman Bhatia to step down at the end of the year
stories.quote: Starling Bank CEO Raman Bhatia will step down at the end of the year , after just over two years at the company.

stories.headline: Plural raises a new €1bn fund
stories.quote: Early stage VC firm Plural raised a new €1bn fund to back “non-obvious companies.”

stories.headline: Stark Future raises €150m led by Highland Europe
stories.quote: Barcelona, Spain-based Stark Future, which designs, builds and sells high-performance electric motorcycles, raised €150m in funding. Highland Europe led the round and was joined by investors including Morgan Stanley and Axon Partners Group.
stories.description: Designs, builds and sells high-performance electric motorcycles

stories.headline: Intergrid raises €23.5m led by Kvanted and Tesi
stories.quote: Helsinki-based Intergrid, which runs an AI autopilot that operates industrial hybrid energy systems and trades on power markets around the clock, raised €23.5m in funding. Kvanted and Tesi led the round
stories.description: AI autopilot operating industrial hybrid energy systems and trading power markets

stories.headline: Daisytuner raises €6m seed led by Elaia and LEA Ventures
stories.quote: Darmstadt, Germany-based Daisytuner, which is building an open-source AI compiler that turns framework code into native code for Nvidia, AMD and newer accelerator chips, raised €6m in seed funding. Elaia and LEA Ventures led the round
stories.description: Open-source AI compiler turning framework code into native code for accelerator chips

stories.headline: Valeria raises €5.5m seed led by BlackFin Capital Partners
stories.quote: Barcelona, Spain-based Valeria, which provides an AI-powered HR and payroll platform for businesses with high staff turnover, raised €5.5m in seed funding. BlackFin Capital Partners led the round
stories.description: AI-powered HR and payroll platform for businesses with high staff turnover
